My ex-girlfriend introduce me to E and I was shocked! I never expreienced anything like this before. But, it was so fuckin expansive and I couldn't handle it by my monthly income. I dropped three or four times a week and that meant 10-15 rolls a week. In the States, it only 20-25 dollars but in Korea, it's 50-60 dollar a pill. This guy I know was dealing and he was making a bank. One day, he suggested if I wanted to help him out with his bussiness, and for the return, he would give me free pills.
The bussiness went well and I was selling 20-30 pills a week and dropped for free every weekend. As I was doing this for couple weeks, I thought to myself maybe I should start dealing too. 20 -30 pills mean 1000-2000 dollar profit a week and that would definitly, help me out. So I went to NewYork and brought back 200 Tazs to see how  it goes. First I sold 30-40 pills a week. I was making alot of money and girls were coming on to me left and right.
In korea, since the pills are so expansive, girl actually fuck dealers for free pills. Income was great, my sex life was great, I didn't have anything to ask more. Later on that month, my friend sent 500 Superdomes from L.A and I was ready to fire up my bussines. Life was never been better and I was having so much fun. By then, I had couple people working for me to sell the pills and one of them was my girlfriend.
Actually, we can't really say we dated b/c she was with me so she can dropp for free and I was with her b/c she knew lot of ravers who dropped and was a hell of a good fuck! Anyways, trouble started after I met her. After a month with I ended up getting arrested for possesion of 340 pills and 70 grams of weed. She got arrested first and she ratt me out. I was supposed to do major time but my dad got me out (mad connection and money).
